name: Kundali Mala Yogini Bhayankari Trinayani
text:
कुण्डलीमाला योगिनी भयङ्करी त्रिनयनी ।
शवशिवारूढा सृजनारूढा जनदा जननी ॥
meaning: A fierce three-eyed Yogini adorned with the Kundalini garland, associated with the imagery of the cremation ground and with the power of creation and motherhood.
purpose: A fierce Goddess invocation associated with protection, transformation and the meeting of life and death.
supports: Facing fear; strengthening boundaries; reflecting on transformation and the power to begin again.
when: Only where this wording is part of one’s established devotional practice.
note: This wording is the one supplied for the library. It has not yet been traced to a published source, and the variant in the client list (“Kundali Mala Jogi…”) differs. Both are kept as separate witnesses, not merged.
supplied:
Kundali Mala Jogi Bhayankari,
Trinayani Sava Shiva Rudha,
Shri Jana Rudha Jandar Janani.
